name: shore
description: Acceptance 19–21: run requests go through the run-request API and wait for its poll; climatology and export bundles wait for the shore link.

steps.caption: The watchkeeper requests a run. It reaches the run-request API, not the orchestrator.
A second request before the next poll: both are taken by one poll and merge into one queued run.
Shore issues climatology v2 at T+02:00 while the link is down; it crosses when the link is next up.
